decision: Qualify TQP-35 for the retained bounded Windows native LOD1/LOD0 dynamic-publication profile after correcting world-transvoxel collision staging so old and replacement hierarchy bodies are never simultaneously live.
alternatives_considered: accept collision continuity while allowing parent and child StaticBody3D ownership to overlap
disable collision during LOD replacement and tolerate transient collision holes
weaken the laboratory double-collision invariant after it detected the upstream behavior
qualify settled screenshots without a complete frame-state trace
claim deeper LOD, crossfade, edit, fault-injection, or production behavior from the bounded LOD1/LOD0 run
evidence: two cold qualification runs with exact checkpoint-matrix and reload-state signature agreement
1,184 retained audited frames covering split, merge, replacement, rapid supersession, stale viewer rejection, presentation rebase, teleport, unload, and deterministic restart
zero visible-hole, render-overlap, double-collision, generation-incoherence, material-mutation, and frame-failure observations
eight parent-to-child split and four child-to-parent merge observations, 603 replacement frames, 50 transition completions, three coalesced viewer events, and one stale application rejection
world-transvoxel regression coverage proving collision continuity and zero live parent/child collision overlap while collision replacement resources are staged
debug timing distributions, memory telemetry, provenance, full frame trace, exact mesh/material signatures, focused runner, and four-state @tool observatory capture sequence
qualified_scope: actual concurrent native world-transvoxel procedural generation and bounded LOD1/LOD0 publication on the retained Windows debug profile
atomic split, merge, replacement, rapid viewer supersession, stale-result rejection, teleport, viewer unload, and deterministic world reload
frame-by-frame render and collision ownership, generation, material, hole, and overlap invariants
Godot parent-transform presentation rebasing without mutation of native local publication state
retained deterministic signatures, performance distributions, provenance, full frame trace, and editor motion evidence
unqualified_scope: native floating-origin or large-coordinate remapping beyond presentation-parent rebasing
dynamic LOD2 and deeper hierarchies, crossfade visual quality, and arbitrary viewer arrangements
cross-LOD edits, digging, construction, adaptive materials, persistence, and multi-layer streaming owned by TQP-36 through TQP-41
fault injection and schedule-order determinism owned by TQP-42
production frame-time, GPU performance, other hardware, other platforms, and release qualification
review: Qualification must fail closed if the retained report, full trace, exact signatures, motion capture hashes, upstream staged-collision behavior, focused runner, program validation, or preservation smoke tests differ. The original laboratory run recorded 289 double-collision frames; that result was rejected and retained as the defect trigger, not promoted.
downstream_impact: TQP-36 becomes the next dependency-ordered milestone. Gate E remains closed. TQP-35 does not authorize adaptive edits, materials, persistence, deeper LOD, GPU authority, or production terrain. A world-transvoxel source and binary correction was required.
